audience: teams that track projects, tasks and onboarding in Zenkit lists

useCases.title: Search all lists for an entry
useCases.text: Search every list you can access for a word, such as 'invoice'. Open a match to read its field values, checklists and timestamps.

useCases.title: Map the workspaces and lists in an account
useCases.text: Check which Zenkit user the key belongs to. Then list the workspaces with their lists, and open one workspace for its name and description.

useCases.title: Read a list's fields and members
useCases.text: Read the fields of a list, with their types and sort order. Then check which users have access to the list and their roles.

useCases.title: Review recent changes in a list
useCases.text: Read the newest changes and comments in one list, newest first, with paging. Open the entries they touch to check the current values.
